subject: ballet dancer spinning
title: What If You Spun Like a Ballet Dancer Every Day?

scenes.text: What if you spun like a ballet dancer every day? Your brain would physically change.
Spin fast and stop, and the fluid in your inner ear keeps swirling. The room seems to keep turning.
Scientists spun twenty-nine ballet dancers and twenty rowers in a chair, in the dark.
In the dancers, the dizzy feeling and the eye flicker it triggers both faded faster.
Brain scans showed why: the part of the cerebellum handling the spinning signal was smaller in dancers.
Years of training had turned down their dizziness. Not just by spotting, but by rewiring the brain.

description:
What if you spun like a ballet dancer every day? A 2013 Imperial College London study spun 29 ballet dancers and 20 rowers in a chair in the dark.
The dancers' dizziness and eye reflexes faded faster, and brain scans showed a smaller area in the cerebellum that processes signals from the balance organs.
